environment.mode: headless; foreground page; no CPU/network throttling

workload.note: Synthetic supported Tap/Hold load. Slide performance is outside the current unverified scope.

warmImport.scope: page postMessage through real WASM parser + TS model + snapshot receipt; file read and React paint excluded

seek.scope: input dispatch through two animation frames; no loaded media

inputFeedback.scope: real pointerdown to two animation frames; placement preview, before Worker commit

memoryLimitations: CDP page heap is not total memory; excludes some worker/WASM/GPU/audio allocations. No physical output latency claim.
